items.source_en:
From: Dr. Erin Kang
Subject: DON'T HIT SEND!!!
Date: 30 Telona, 7968 C.RC

Dr. Eubanks,
I would strongly advise you do yourself a favor and DON'T HIT SEND on that message to Commander Natara, or at the very least, omit the part about the ventriloquist. You are playing with dragon fire here.

That message is not subtle at all. "Certain benefits?" Really Marcin? Are you crazy? You're basically admitting you were part of Commander Woods' scheme. We need to lean into the fact that the ComSpike is working and a success, and refer every question to Dr. Vogel. 

I don't know if he's a savant or just out of his mind, but Dr. Vogel is the kind of engineer who will come into a meeting with a sack full of parts, dump them on the floor, and pray to a toaster that a pattern emerges. Five minutes with him, and Commander Natara will never question our expenditures again.

Dr. Vogel is our buffer against any investigation. The fact that we have him leading Project UCE-86 is a gift from the universe. Let's not waste it.

Chapter I: Adaptation and Survival

[Included is a rather incomprehensible catalog of galactic species and their variations.]

When we examine the individuals of the same species across different star systems, one of the first observations that strikes us is how their traits often vary drastically, shaped by the environments of their homeworlds. Take the banthas, for example—on desert worlds like Tatooine, their shaggy fur thins out and their endurance increases, while on temperate planets like Kashyyyk, they develop thicker coats and broader frames. Such adaptations are a response to local climates, predators, and even sentient domestication practices.

Reflecting on the vast diversity of fauna and flora across the galaxy, one must acknowledge the role of time, climate, and external pressures in shaping life. From the predatory nexu of Cholganna to the gentle nerfs of Alderaan, the immense variability observed arises from the interplay between natural evolution and sentient cultivation.

[Doctor Lys Renno’s seminal work on the origin of species across the galaxy spans 14 comprehensive chapters, ranging from biological adaptations to the environmental influences that shape life on countless worlds.]

Chapter I Variation Under Domestication

[Included is a rather incomprehensible list of varieties of species.]

items.source_en:
A variety of goods and services are available from vendors across the Galaxy. 

- Bars - You can buy drinks and food. Bars are also good places to find Mission Board terminals, ask around for rumors, and find new crew members to hire. 

- Inns - You can rent a room to rest. 

- Outfitters - Purchase clothes, spacesuits, packs, crafting components, and other essentials. 

- Reliant Medical - Purchase medical supplies and treatment.

- Enhance! - You can change your appearance at Enhance! locations. 

- Weapon Stores - There are many different arms dealers across the Galaxy that sell different types of blasters, ammo, and other weapons.

- Ship Services Technicians and Staryards - Allows you to buy, sell, and modify starships, as well as offering repair services.
